messages:
Asha: AltoTech emailed — urgent demo request next Friday, wants a customer-isolated POC tenant plus clarity on pilot pricing (hosted vs dedicated). They also attached a security pack.

Miguel: I can run the tenant build. Do we want to allocate a short-lived scoped tenant or use the shared sandbox? For customer demos isolated is better.

Noah: We have a shared sandbox but its noisy. I can spin an isolated tenant today if we have: entitlement id, owner contact, and SSO callback.

Asha: Owner is platform@alto.com. They asked for SP-initiated SAML, SCIM for groups long-term, but will accept CSV for the demo. Also asked for SOC2 Type II evidence and a pen-test contact.

Priya: For Sales: offer hosted pilot with a 12% partner discount for pilot usage. If they convert to Dedicated within 60 days, give 2 months free on the first 6-month commit. Ill tabulate costs when we confirm throughput.

Miguel: Need expected profiles: chat concurrency and embedding batch size. Also confirm whether they need private IP egress / VPC peering or will use allowlisted IPs.

Asha: They expect demo bursts ~200 qps for chat during the live session, otherwise <30 qps steady. Embedding job ~60k/day. They prefer IP allowlist for the demo window not full VPC peering.

Sam: Security checklist: must obtain SAML metadata XML, SCIM base URL + auth mechanism, SOC2 report link. Confirm data classification: no PHI/PCI in demo. Request pen-test contact to coordinate scanning windows.

Noah: Provision command (internal admin API):

`````
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood.dev/tenants -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"name":"alto-poc-2612","owner":"platform@alto.com","entitlement":"partner_poc_v3","quota":{"gpu_hours":100,"token_limit_per_min":120000}}'
`````

Noah: Ill run that when Asha confirms the owner email and the 3 IP ranges to open. Post-create Ill attach a logging sink and a read-only SIEM export role. ETA ~2-4 hours.

Miguel: Canary plan: deploy chat model tuned for low-latency with a small KV cache, test at 50, 100, 200 simulated users in 10m ramps, measure p95 latency and token throughput. For embeddings use batch size 64 off-peak. If p95 breaks, fallback to quantized variant.

Priya: Ill produce a one-pager: hosted pilot pricing with discount, Dedicated migration terms, and estimated monthly burn for the pilot numbers. Posting draft by EOD.

Asha: Alto okayed CSV group sync for demo. Sending SAML metadata + SOC2 link in next email. Also confirmed no regulated data for the demo.

Sam: Great. Once we have SAML metadata Ill validate ACS URL and ensure SP-initiated flow policy is set. Also will prepare a short pen-test window (48hrs notice).

integration-bot: Tenant provisioning request queued (req: rq_3b2c). You will receive a completion notice.

Noah: Logged. After provisioning Ill add firewall rules to allow only Alto IPs for 72 hours and set token quotas per the payload.

Miguel: After tenant is live Ill drop the canary playbook and a minimal runbook for the demo team (rollback steps, model switch commands, and cache warmers).

Priya: Invite sent for a 25-min presales technical sync Tue 11am to review SSO, SCIM fallback, pilot SLA, and pricing.

Asha: Action list recap:
- Asha: deliver SAML metadata, SOC2, and IP ranges (today)
- Miguel: prepare perf/canary runbook (post-provision)
- Noah: provision tenant and attach logging sink (after owner + IPs)
- Sam: validate SAML metadata and coordinate pen-test window (48hrs)
- Priya: finalize pilot commercial one-pager (EOD)

Noah: Will provision once owner email confirmed and quota OK. If infra throttles we fallback to shared sandbox but prefer dedicated tenant for the demo.

Miguel: Note on SCIM provisioning: full SCIM sync will need attribute mapping; for immediate demo stick with CSV to avoid mapping delays.

Asha: Thanks team, looks like were on track. Ill post Altos email thread here as soon as it arrives. :rocket:
